title: Vision Transformer Adapter for Dense Predictions
mechanism: A pretraining-free conv spatial-prior branch with injector/extractor cross-attention turns a plain ViT into a multi-scale dense backbone.
adaptation: DINOv3 ViT-B/16 or L/16 + ViT-Adapter feeding the U-Net++ decoder, plus a stride-1/2 conv stem skip for 1-2 px lines; 1-ch input replicated; PF-style schedule with layer-wise lr decay.
min_experiment: Arm: ViT-L + Adapter + U-Net++ (PF); baseline: house PF; 5-fold CV crack IoU, inactive IoU, then E1 crack relF1@2. Kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.03 and CV crack IoU n.d.
evidence: R: ViT-Adapter-L 60.9 box AP / 53.0 mask AP on COCO test-dev; used by DINOv2 for its segmentation evaluation (web search, not tool-verified).
prior_overlap: Foundation row: no ViT fine-tune or adapter was run. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: DINOv3 ViT-B/16 or L/16 + ViT-Adapter feeding a U-Net++ decoder plus a stride-1/2 conv stem skip; 1-ch input replicated; PF-style schedule (frozen 1k steps, 0.1x lr, layer-wise lr decay).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm ViT-Adapter-DINOv3-B + U-Net++ vs house PF on 5-fold CV crack IoU, relF1@2, inactive IoU, mIoU_rob, then E1. Kill: E1 crack relF1@2 < +0.03 and CV crack IoU drop > 0.012. About 25 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: ViT-B DINOv2 + adapter + M2F or UPerNet at 1024 px; the conv prior gives a 1/4-res path that thin cracks and gridlines need; use if EoMT-L memory/time is a problem or ViT-B is preferred.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm ViT-B DINOv2 + ViT-Adapter + UPerNet, 5-fold CV; baseline house PF; metrics mIoU_rob, inactive IoU, E1 relF1@2; kill if all below house.

alt_notes.adaptation: ViT-B DINOv2 + adapter + M2F or UPerNet at 1024 px; the conv branch supplies the fine path thin cracks need, where EoMT at ViT-B loses most.
alt_notes.min_experiment: ViT-B DINOv2 + adapter + UPerNet vs EoMT-B and house, 5-fold; metric crack relF1@2, inactive IoU, mIoU_rob; kill if below EoMT-B and house on all three.
